Other.problem: How do societies manage monsoon waterlogging prevention?
Other.summary: Residential areas face repeated waterlogging during monsoons due to clogged drains. Citizens report issues but municipal action is slow. No preventive drain cleaning happens. Communities cannot crowdsource drain clearing or get real-time waterlogging alerts for route planning.
